concept.title: Links, and links to hidden topics
concept.shortdesc: Link with xref or related-links. A link to a topic the reader cannot see turns into plain text, so it never gives away what is behind it.

ul.li: An empty link shows the target topic's title as the reader sees it.
Links to other local files, such as a sample YAML file, are served like images, only to readers who can see the linking topic.
A link to a missing file, topic or element is an error, broken-link.
related-links with link elements render as a "Related information" list. Links whose target is hidden are left out of it.

section.title: Links to hidden topics
section.p: Pages are shared by many readers, so a page often links to a topic some of its readers cannot see. For those readers, the link renders as its authored text, without the target's title and without a URL. A link with no authored text disappears.

section.title: Links to topics outside the navigation
section.p: A topic that is in no navigation entry is never published, so links to it are plain text for everyone. Validation warns about them as link-to-unpublished. Add the topic to the site map, with toc="no" if it should not be listed.
In PDF publications, links to topics in the same publication jump within the PDF; links to other topics point at the docs site when the reader can see them there.
